howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 AM PDT 13 August 2026 Today Tonight and Friday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 5 to 15 knots becoming light this morning then increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 near noon except southwesterly inflow 20 to 25 over northern sections. Wind diminishing to light early this evening then becoming northerly outflow 5 to 15 late overnight. Wind becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon Friday except southwesterly inflow 15 to 20 over northern sections. Wind becoming light Friday evening. Showers tonight and Friday with a risk of thunderstorms tonight and Friday afternoon. <h2 class="h3 mrgn-tp-0"

strait_of_georgia_south.label: Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo)
strait_of_georgia_south.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 AM PDT 13 August 2026 Today Tonight and Friday. Wind light becoming northwest 5 to 15 knots early this morning then becoming light near noon. Wind becoming southeast 5 to 15 this evening then becoming light late overnight. Wind light Friday. Scattered showers overnight and Friday morning with a risk of thunderstorms. <h2 class="h3 mrgn-tp-0"

Classic Squamish summer thermal: valley heats, draws air up Howe Sound from the south. Multiple models agree, which is a good sign for a thermal-driven day. Field-calibrated: raw coarse-model wind (~4kt) is scaled up ~2.85x, matching how this thermal typically under-reads on GFS-class models (source: local rider calibration, see README). Caution: MSLP doesn't clearly support inflow yet (large-scale -0.5hPa, local 0.5hPa) — could be weaker or more marginal than the wind signal alone suggests.
